question: What is the meaning of available spare parts in relation to maintenance and repair information?
description: Available spare parts are parts that can be used to repair a product. They are identified and listed as supplementary information to the statement about the ability to disassemble and repair the product. This information is relevant to the repairability of a product and is typically detailed in the supplementary information field associated with the statement.
